jei.yanscriptures.annihilated.source: Source: throw Corrupt Parchment into lava that has a lit beacon directly below its column with its beam unobstructed; 66% of the time it becomes Annihilated Parchment, otherwise it burns up.
jei.yanscriptures.annihilated.use: Use: the paper with the highest material tier (tier IV). Put it on the table as paper and the paper line of the written book gets +6%; it can also serve as the paper slot on a smithing table to raise an old book's paper to tier IV.
jei.yanscriptures.blank_scroll.use:
Use ①: place it on the Book Writing Table as the blank scroll and write a book together with paper, ink and thread.
Use ②: use it as the template on a smithing table — the template is the blank scroll (consumed), the middle is a book, the third slot is paper/ink/thread — to raise that line's material tier and reroll that line's random attribute (tiers never go down).
jei.yanscriptures.book.aeneid.detail.1: · "Non-boss" means hostile + monster category + max health ≥ 150; undead means creatures whose vanilla attribute is undead (zombies, skeletons, phantoms, and anything another mod declares undead).
jei.yanscriptures.book.aeneid.detail.2: · Undead are neutral to you: when they retarget, picking you is cleared outright; but once you hit one yourself it fights back normally for 15 seconds.
jei.yanscriptures.book.aeneid.detail.3: · Counterattack for you: for 10 seconds after a non-undead hits you, undead within 16 blocks that carry no boss tag are sent after that creature.
jei.yanscriptures.book.aeneid.detail.4: · Inversion only applies to magic/wither damage with no attacker and to potion effects themselves; another player hitting you with a sword still hurts.
jei.yanscriptures.book.analects.detail.1: · Counts within 16 blocks, only your own pets and minions, capped at 10 (other players and passive animals do not count).
jei.yanscriptures.book.analects.detail.2: · Damage bonus = 5% × number of pets and minions, applied directly to final damage.
jei.yanscriptures.book.analects.detail.3: · After each hit you heal 1% × number of pets and minions of your max health.
jei.yanscriptures.book.art_of_war.detail: · Backstab check: a facing dot product above 0.5 counts as behind — guaranteed crit and +30% on that hit.
· +15% extra damage when the target has not taken you as its aggro target.
· Hold Shift for Invisibility II, which ends when you release; only the copy this book granted is removed.
jei.yanscriptures.book.capital.detail.1: · Capital from a kill equals the creature's max health, at most 100 per kill (a 200-health mob still gives 100).
jei.yanscriptures.book.capital.detail.2: · +50 for trading with a villager; +15 for trading with a piglin using gold ingots (handing it the ingot by right-click, or dropping the ingot at its feet and letting it pick it up — both count).
jei.yanscriptures.book.capital.detail.3: · The attack bonus adds up in steps of 500, capping at +30% with 15000 capital.
jei.yanscriptures.book.capital.detail.4: · Capital lives on the player: death halves it, logging out and back in does not clear it; taking the book off only suspends the bonus, it does not reset capital.
jei.yanscriptures.book.crime_and_punishm: · Each enemy you personally kill adds 1 layer, up to 10; each layer: +2% damage dealt and +2% damage taken.
· At 10 layers the invulnerability window after a hit is 0.2 s shorter (vanilla 10 ticks becomes 6), and final damage taken becomes ×1.2.
· Cleared at once on death or when unequipped, so re-equipping cannot farm layers.
jei.yanscriptures.book.critique_of_pure_: · Enchantments count by the number of distinct enchantments in a slot: an item with two enchantments counts 2, and two separate Sharpness books in two slots count 2.
· The range is the hotbar, inventory and armor slots; an enchantment book filling a slot does not count.
· Creative flight requires "more than 21 slots holding items", each of them enchanted; empty slots are fine.
· The damage reduction applies to all creatures as long as you have not hit them yourself; once you hit one, this clause stops working on it.
jei.yanscriptures.book.dao_de_jing.detai: · While at empty health your health is held at 0.5 (half a heart) and no death check triggers.
· While at empty health each hit taken raises Regeneration by one level, up to V.
· Going from empty back to full health really does kill you — that is by design, not a bug.
· Taking the book off ends the empty-health state at once.

· If you are still at empty health when the 30 seconds end and your health is below 5 (or 10% of max, whichever is higher), you die as well; raising it above the death line without filling it counts as surviving.
jei.yanscriptures.book.de_revolutionibus: · The sun (gold), moon (silver) and earth (blue) form an equilateral triangle orbiting you horizontally: 10 second period, 1.5 block radius.
· Earth touching a creature: a random positive effect for 15 seconds; the same effect triggering again raises its level (up to IV).
· Moon touching an enemy: 20% attack damage plus a random harmful effect for 15 seconds; level I at noon, level V at midnight.
· Sun touching an enemy: 150% attack damage; 250% at noon, 50% at midnight, cosine-smoothed in between.
· The three bodies are real entities, not particles; they orbit you and follow you.
jei.yanscriptures.book.divine_comedy.det: · Triggered with Shift + T; the landing spot is chosen at random in another dimension, and only one extra chunk is generated while searching.
· On landing: 60 seconds of Resistance II, Regeneration III, Night Vision and Fire Resistance; +15% movement speed.
jei.yanscriptures.book.don_quixote.detai: · +20% when the enemy's health is 10× your max health, +50% at 20×, linear in between.
· Resistance III while riding a horse or a boat.
jei.yanscriptures.book.euclid.detail.1: · Each of the five axioms blocks one lethal hit; spent axioms are not replenished unless all five are rewritten 10 minutes later.
jei.yanscriptures.book.euclid.detail.2: · Postulates unlock with the number of axioms: -10% damage taken, +10% damage dealt, +20% experience, no single hit above 90% of max health, +1 reach.
jei.yanscriptures.book.euclid.detail.3: · Axiom state is stored on the player, so taking the book off and on does not refresh the count.
jei.yanscriptures.book.faust.detail.1: · Each pact multiplies your max health by 0.8 (another 20% gone) and never drops it below 5.
jei.yanscriptures.book.faust.detail.2: · In exchange, 60 seconds of +50% damage dealt, -50% damage taken and +50% movement speed; 60 second cooldown.
jei.yanscriptures.book.faust.detail.3: · The loss does not come back when unequipped; only death and respawn or a command clears it.
· Each level of Hero of the Village: +15% max health, +15% attack damage.
· Hold a sword, hold R for 5 seconds, release after the full 5 to fire.
· The slash runs 96 blocks along your line of sight and widens with distance; damage is 10000% of your attack damage.
· If the target has a damage cap, a follow-up of "actual health removed × 10" is added instead. 600 second cooldown.
· The whole cone the slash passes through (including empty space inside the ring) is carved out: stone, wood, leaves, grass, dirt, water and lava. Nothing drops.
jei.yanscriptures.book.hamlet.detail.1: · The four weights add up to 100%: 10% → 15% damage, 50% → 35% damage, 150% → 35% damage, 200% → 15% damage.
jei.yanscriptures.book.hamlet.detail.2: · Rolling the 10% bracket banks a "next hit always crits", spent on your next attack only.
jei.yanscriptures.book.hamlet.detail.3: · Rolling the 200% bracket resolves this hit as a crit outright.
jei.yanscriptures.book.hamlet.detail.4: · Crit multiplier = 1 + crit damage attribute (at least the vanilla 150%).
jei.yanscriptures.book.how: [How to use] Put it in the Book slot of the curios menu to take effect; several books can be worn at once and their effects stack.
jei.yanscriptures.book.hundred_years.det: · With no other player within 24 blocks: +20% damage dealt, -20% damage taken.
· +40% damage while carrying fewer than 5 items; once the inventory is more than half full you cannot read item names.
jei.yanscriptures.book.i_ching.detail.1: · While worn a new hexagram is drawn every 60 seconds, cycling through the six; only one is active at a time.
jei.yanscriptures.book.i_ching.detail.2: · Qian: +10% attack damage; each attack has a 50% chance to add another hit (does not consume invulnerability).
jei.yanscriptures.book.i_ching.detail.3: · Kun: -10% damage taken, knockback immunity; 50% chance to reflect half of the damage taken.
jei.yanscriptures.book.i_ching.detail.4: · Zhen: +15% movement speed; while sprinting the bonus is final movement speed × 200% (+10% speed is 0.11 → +22%).
jei.yanscriptures.book.i_ching.detail.5: · Kan: +30% swimming speed, water breathing; in water -50% damage taken and +30% damage dealt.
jei.yanscriptures.book.i_ching.detail.6: · Li: attacks set the target alight for 3 seconds, fire and lava immunity; burning enemies take +15% and get a random harmful effect.
jei.yanscriptures.book.i_ching.detail.7: · Gen: -80% damage taken while standing still.
jei.yanscriptures.book.iliad.detail.1: · Duel check: only one creature within 8 blocks targets you → +15% attack damage, -10% damage taken.
jei.yanscriptures.book.iliad.detail.2: · During the duel neither you nor your opponent can be weakened by attribute-lowering effects or blinded, nauseated, levitated, darkened, poisoned or withered.
jei.yanscriptures.book.iliad.detail.3: · Locked by 2 or more creatures: -10% attack damage, but every hit adds a random harmful effect at level II for 8 seconds.
jei.yanscriptures.book.iliad.detail.4: · While surrounded, every hit also deals 50% sweep damage to other enemies within 2.5 blocks.
jei.yanscriptures.book.inner_canon_of_th: · Damage reduction = current health percentage - 50% (the fuller your health, the less it saves; at half health or below there is none).
· The reduction is settled when damage is taken and stacks with armor and resistance.
· The five phases rotate every 30 seconds, always in the order wood → fire → earth → metal → water.
· Rotation follows world time: putting the book on mid-cycle joins the current phase instead of restarting at wood.
jei.yanscriptures.book.interpretation_of: · Shift + D to dream for 30 seconds, 10 minute cooldown.
· In the dream you pass through walls and ignore gravity: Space rises, Shift sinks, releasing both hovers; movement speed is vanilla survival speed.
· Creatures within 32 blocks dream along: they do not move, take no damage, do not burn, recognise no one, and hitting them only shows the hurt animation and sound.
· Damage you deal in the dream does not land; 30% of the total is settled on them the moment you wake.
· Waking up (or disconnecting) returns you to where you were standing when you fell asleep.
jei.yanscriptures.book.materia_medica.de: · Effects from potions drunk and food eaten gain +2 levels, up to level IV.
· Resistance is only raised while its original level is 1–2, so it never becomes full immunity.
jei.yanscriptures.book.nicomachean_ethic: · The counter only grows while "a hostile creature is watching you" or "you are attacking a hostile creature"; passive creatures do not count.
· One layer every 5 seconds, in order: movement speed → attack → crit rate and crit damage → damage dealt → bonus damage; later layers include the earlier ones.
· Taking any damage resets the timer to zero and removes every layer at once — you start over.
· 10 seconds without fighting also counts as leaving combat and resets it.
jei.yanscriptures.book.nine_chapters.det: · Attack with hotbar slots 1/1/2/3/5/8 in Fibonacci order: +10%/10%/20%/30%/50%/80%.
· One mistake in the order clears every stacked bonus and makes the next hit another -10%.
jei.yanscriptures.book.odyssey.detail.1: · On death your inventory and curios slots are preserved (including everything in Curios) and restored on respawn.
jei.yanscriptures.book.odyssey.detail.2: · For 30 seconds after respawning: Regeneration IV, Absorption IV, Strength III, Swiftness III.
jei.yanscriptures.book.odyssey.detail.3: · With keepInventory on, Shift + right-click teleports you back to your last death point.
jei.yanscriptures.book.on_war.detail.1: · Morale only counts damage taken, capped at max health × 20%.
jei.yanscriptures.book.on_war.detail.2: · The first hit at full morale: guaranteed crit plus extra true damage (ignores armor, enchantments and resistance).
jei.yanscriptures.book.on_war.detail.3: · Morale resets to zero after it fires; there is no cooldown — take enough damage again and it fires again.
jei.yanscriptures.book.on_war.detail.4: · Morale falls to zero 10 seconds after leaving combat.
jei.yanscriptures.book.one_thousand_and_: · Only a full night's sleep counts: being interrupted or woken up gives no growth.
· Settled once per in-game day; sleeping the same night twice does not stack.
· Attribute growth is given in percentages (armor and toughness are flat, given in points) and is shown in the Book slot panel.
· [Story] is once per day and does not consume a growth tick when it triggers.
jei.yanscriptures.book.origin.detail.1: · After taking the same kind of damage 10 times in a row, that type is permanently -25%, with no limit on how many types.
jei.yanscriptures.book.origin.detail.2: · Environmental damage (fall, fire, lava and the like) -50%.
jei.yanscriptures.book.origin.detail.3: · After defeating the same boss a second time, +100% damage against it, permanently.
jei.yanscriptures.book.records_of_the_hi: · Each completed advancement adds a permanent stack of bonuses, kept even when the book is taken off.
· Crit rate and crit damage read the equipment system's crit attributes; without that mod these two do nothing.
· +0.2 luck per stack, stacking with the vanilla luck attribute.
jei.yanscriptures.book.republic.detail.1: · The shadow spawns 1.1 blocks from the target on the side facing you and fades after 10 seconds.
jei.yanscriptures.book.republic.detail.2: · Stand where one swing covers both the body and the shadow and you deal two hits.
jei.yanscriptures.book.republic.detail.3: · The shadow is not a real entity: it drops nothing, grants no experience and is not recorded as a mob by other mods.
· [Son], [Father] and [Spirit] are triggered by "taking damage", "dealing damage" and "gaining experience"; each refreshes its own 10 second timer independently.
· The [Father] ring settles once per second; its damage is based on your attack damage, benefits from all damage bonuses, but does not consume the enemy's invulnerability frames.
· The [Spirit] attribute bonus only applies while its mark exists; the doubled drops only apply to creatures you kill.
· While wearing The Covenant Codex every value is raised to the bracketed tier; each extra commandment blessing adds +5% to the base value.
· [Son]: damage above 700% of your max health is ignored entirely, otherwise you take at most 49%.
jei.yanscriptures.book.the_count_of_mont: · The list only records creatures that have dealt damage to you; monsters you hit do not join it.
· Creatures you kill, or that die on their own, are removed from the list.
· The red outline uses team colouring and does not interfere with other mods' glowing effects.
· The attack speed only applies while the list is non-empty; clearing the list removes it at once.
jei.yanscriptures.book.the_prince.detail: · Health ≥ 80%: +8% attack damage; health ≤ 30%: -15% damage taken and +10% movement speed.
· Minions and pets of yours within 16 blocks: +20% health, armor and attack (recognised by entity tag, including the various Goety servants).
· The aura is removed automatically about 5 seconds after a minion leaves the radius.
jei.yanscriptures.book.thirty_six_strate: · Below 30% health you turn invisible for 6 seconds and movement speed ×2.
· While invisible you cannot be targeted at all: anything already locked on loses you at once, and new locks fail.
· 30 second cooldown; while worn, nearby creatures' detection range is another -35%.
jei.yanscriptures.book.tiangong_kaiwu.de: · Anvil experience cost is halved, still at least 1 level.
· Enchanting table base level +20, decided by "someone wearing it within 8 blocks of the table".
· On multiplayer servers, another player wearing the book beside your table also counts — that is the price of not modifying the table itself.
jei.yanscriptures.book.wealth_of_nations: · Wealth only looks at the hotbar (9 slots) and inventory (27 slots); armor slots and offhand do not count.
· Counted by item id: the same id counts once no matter how many slots it fills.
· 11 kinds = 1 point, 22 kinds = 2 points, 33 or more = 3 points.
· All three effects are active at once; they do not overwrite each other.
jei.yanscriptures.book.zarathustra.detai: · While worn, both blessings and curses of the Ten Commandments stop, effectively silencing the whole law.
· Each curse suppressed: -3% to all attributes; each blessing suppressed: +4% to all attributes.
jei.yanscriptures.book.zhuangzi.detail.1: · Fall damage is zeroed outright, blocked once at the event layer and once at the damage-type layer.
jei.yanscriptures.book.zhuangzi.detail.2: · Hold Space in mid-air: falling speed never exceeds 0.08 blocks per tick; hold Shift to accelerate the fall further.
jei.yanscriptures.book.zhuangzi.detail.3: · +20% movement speed while gliding (elytra or glider).
jei.yanscriptures.book.zhuangzi.detail.4: · While gliding with an empty main hand, hold right-click to add a push along your line of sight every 4 ticks.
jei.yanscriptures.book_table.source: Source: Shift + right-click a vanilla lectern while holding the Writing Quill, and the lectern becomes a Book Writing Table.
jei.yanscriptures.book_table.use: Use: write a book — put a blank scroll in the book slot, paper, ink and thread in the three selector slots, and any other required materials in the pool below; use the small up/down triangles on the right to pick among the books those three slots can write, then click to write it.
jei.yanscriptures.epic.calamity: Acquire: kill 50 or more enemies in one fight.
jei.yanscriptures.epic.creation: Acquire: heal 100 or more points within 1 second.
jei.yanscriptures.epic.fate: Acquire: while below 10% health, be healed back by a single heal above 50% of your max health.
jei.yanscriptures.epic.hint: Granted automatically when the condition is met; these four are the materials of As I Have Written. (The fifth, Epic of the Self, is granted by the modpack's quests.)
jei.yanscriptures.epic.pillar: Acquire: take 496 or more damage in one fight without dying.
jei.yanscriptures.scroll.blood.condition: Acquire: 1000 or more total kills and at least 5 bosses.
jei.yanscriptures.scroll.harp.condition: Acquire: keep a pet you tamed alive for 7 full in-game days.
jei.yanscriptures.scroll.hint: When you meet the condition only a "ready" mark appears; you must also wear the Scripture of Commandments and have already violated that commandment before the fragment actually reaches you.
jei.yanscriptures.scroll.sabbath.conditi: Acquire: go three full in-game days without breaking any block.
jei.yanscriptures.scroll.shema.condition: Acquire: while wearing only this mod's curios in the Book slot (the exemption list aside), kill an enemy with at least 222 max health.
jei.yanscriptures.scroll.shinar.conditio: Acquire: kill a Warden in the Deep Dark.
jei.yanscriptures.scroll.silence.conditi: Acquire: survive a single hit of at least 120% of your max health without relying on any death-prevention effect.
jei.yanscriptures.scroll.tongue.conditio: Acquire: kill 7 or more enemies in a single explosion.
jei.yanscriptures.scroll.vanity.conditio: Acquire: with inventory, armor and offhand completely empty, kill an enemy with at least 300 max health.
jei.yanscriptures.writing_quill.use: Use: hold it and Shift + right-click a vanilla lectern to convert the lectern into a Book Writing Table.

message.yanscriptures.milestone.granted: §6A torn page is revealed out of blood and fire: §e%s
message.yanscriptures.milestone.hint.blo: §8Blood flowed like a river, yet no one demanded it of you.
message.yanscriptures.milestone.hint.cre: §8In a single breath a hundred points of life surged forth.
message.yanscriptures.milestone.hint.fat: §8Your life hung by a thread, and the thread did not break.
message.yanscriptures.milestone.hint.har: §8The harp hung by the river, seven years without changing hands.
message.yanscriptures.milestone.hint.pil: §8Four hundred and ninety-six blows, and you were still the pillar.
message.yanscriptures.milestone.hint.sab: §8Three days without lifting a hand, yet the work was not delayed.
message.yanscriptures.milestone.hint.she: §8You are under His name alone — there is no other god.
message.yanscriptures.milestone.hint.shi: §8In the deep dark you were heavier than the dark.
message.yanscriptures.milestone.hint.sil: §8The shadow of death came upon you, yet it did not break you.
message.yanscriptures.milestone.hint.tho: §8Above a hundred levels, your name could still be spoken.
message.yanscriptures.milestone.hint.ton: §8Sparks fell and burned seven men at once.
message.yanscriptures.milestone.hint.van: §8With nothing at all, you still prevailed.
message.yanscriptures.milestone.pending: §7%s §8is recorded in your name — but it is revealed only after you yourself violate Commandment §c%s§8.
message.yanscriptures.nights.curse_muted: §d[Story] The whisper of the seven curses was drowned by the story you told.
message.yanscriptures.nights.insomnia_wa: §d[Story] Insomnia was pressed down by your telling; you slept deeply this night.
message.yanscriptures.scroll.completed: §5Commandment %s has been restored — it will judge you no more.
message.yanscriptures.scroll.no_scriptur: §cYou do not carry the Scripture of Commandments.
message.yanscriptures.scroll.no_target: §7The Revelation Fragment is not one of the Commandments; there is nothing to restore.
message.yanscriptures.scroll.not_violate: §7Commandment %s has not been violated; there is nothing to restore.
message.yanscriptures.starter_kit: §6Someone left two books in your pack — the Principia and the Scripture of Commandments.
message.yanscriptures.trial.apollyon.l1: §4§lHe that has the power of death comes up out of the bottomless pit
message.yanscriptures.trial.apollyon.l2: §4§lHe comes up out of the bottomless pit; his name is Apollyon
message.yanscriptures.trial.denied.no_ap: §cYou have not overcome the apostle; a dragon-slayer unstained by blood may not approach this seal.
message.yanscriptures.trial.denied.overw: §cThis rite may only be held in the Nether; words of the end are not fulfilled on this shore.
message.yanscriptures.trial.grace.1: §8From now on, the work of destruction of all flesh is at rest.
message.yanscriptures.trial.grace.2: §8The authority of judgement is increased; what comes upon you is not measured by the old measure.
message.yanscriptures.trial.verse.1.l1: §6A door stood open in heaven, and a throne was set in heaven, with a rainbow round about it.
message.yanscriptures.trial.verse.1.l2: §6Out of it came thunders and voices and lightnings; and a voice said: "Come up hither."
message.yanscriptures.trial.verse.2.l1: §6The scroll was sealed with seven seals, and no one was worthy to open it.
message.yanscriptures.trial.verse.2.l2: §6Only the Lamb that was slain came and took the scroll, and the elders fell down and worshipped.
message.yanscriptures.trial.verse.3.l1: §6There was silence in heaven about the space of half an hour, and the trumpets sounded.
message.yanscriptures.trial.verse.3.l2: §6Fire and blood were cast upon the earth, the stars fell, and a third of the earth was judged.
message.yanscriptures.trial.verse.4.l1: §6The dragon and the beast rose up together to make war with the saints.
message.yanscriptures.trial.verse.4.l2: §6At the last the seven bowls were poured out, and a great voice came out of the throne, saying: "It is done."
message.yanscriptures.trial.verse.5.l1: §f§lAnd I saw a new heaven and a new earth; for the first heaven and the first earth were passed away, and there was no more sea.
message.yanscriptures.trial.verse.5.l2: §f§lAnd I heard a great voice out of the throne saying: "Behold, the tabernacle of God is with men."
message.yanscriptures.trial.verse.5.l3: §f§lHe will dwell with them, and they shall be his people; and God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes.
message.yanscriptures.trial.verse.5.l4: §f§lAnd he that sat upon the throne said: "Behold, I make all things new." And he said: "It is done."
message.yanscriptures.writing_quill.conv: §6The lectern has been converted into a Book Writing Table.
tooltip.yanscriptures.blank_page.bonus: Current bonus: +%s max health, +%s attack damage, +%s luck
tooltip.yanscriptures.blank_page.desc: A book waiting to be filled, recording all things in the world. While worn, grants Jump Boost II and a movement speed bonus.
tooltip.yanscriptures.blank_page.how_to_: [Record Enchantment] Hold this book and right-click an enchanted item to record it.
tooltip.yanscriptures.blank_page.not_eno: [Warning] Fewer than 10 usable enchantments — state cannot be recorded!
tooltip.yanscriptures.blank_page.state_h: [State Record] Press %s to spend 10 enchantments and record your current health, hunger and effects. Press %s again to restore them (15 minute cooldown).
tooltip.yanscriptures.blank_page.title: Blank Page
tooltip.yanscriptures.book_of_me.full.10: [Sky] 60% damage reduction while flying, 30% otherwise; immune to sky damage.
tooltip.yanscriptures.book_of_me.full.11: [Sea] Regeneration IV while in water, Regeneration II otherwise; immune to sea damage.
tooltip.yanscriptures.book_of_me.full.13: [World-Bearing] Immune to harmful effects and to instant kills.
tooltip.yanscriptures.book_of_me.full.14: [Reason] Hold Shift + L to give the held item the highest enchantment it can take. 10 second cooldown.
tooltip.yanscriptures.book_of_me.full.15: [Romance] +30% movement speed (separate multiplier); when hit, reflect 200% damage and stun the attacker for 2 seconds.
tooltip.yanscriptures.book_of_me.full.17: [Strife] Attacks remove 8% of the target's max health and apply Wither and Slowness.
tooltip.yanscriptures.book_of_me.full.18: [Death] Each kill grants +1% separate damage, up to 88%.
tooltip.yanscriptures.book_of_me.full.19: [Trickery] Creatures you kill drop more loot; 20% chance to deal double damage.
tooltip.yanscriptures.book_of_me.full.2: Recorded enchantment count is fixed at 093: each enchantment grants +1 max health, +1 attack damage and +0.5 luck.
tooltip.yanscriptures.book_of_me.full.21: Creative flight, +100% flight speed, all attributes ×2, ignores healing prevention, 88% chance to ignore death.
tooltip.yanscriptures.book_of_me.full.22: Whenever a survival effect of this charm triggers, gain 60 seconds of invulnerability.
tooltip.yanscriptures.book_of_me.full.23: Press Z to stop time for 20 seconds. 300 second cooldown.
tooltip.yanscriptures.book_of_me.full.25: Grants Saturation II, Resistance II, Night Vision II, Speed II, Haste II, Glowing II, Strength II, Luck V, Conduit Power II, Hero of the Village V, Fire Resistance and Jump Boost II.
tooltip.yanscriptures.book_of_me.full.3: Press V to record your current state, press V again to rewind to it. 180 second cooldown.
tooltip.yanscriptures.book_of_me.full.5: [Years] Below 10% health, heal 70% and deal void damage equal to twice the healing to enemies within 7 blocks.
tooltip.yanscriptures.book_of_me.full.6: [Gateway] Teleports within 10 blocks are disabled; press K to blink 8~16 blocks along your view (automatically to a safe spot within 16 blocks when near death).
tooltip.yanscriptures.book_of_me.full.7: [Law] A creature that tries to hurt you loses 5% of its max health and cannot regenerate.
tooltip.yanscriptures.book_of_me.full.9: [Earth] Take at most one hit every 2 seconds and never more than 20% of max health; immune to earth damage.
tooltip.yanscriptures.book_of_peace.atta: [Offensive Stance] While not sneaking: +20% damage dealt, +20% damage taken
tooltip.yanscriptures.book_of_peace.defe: [Defensive Stance] While sneaking: -30% damage dealt, -30% damage taken
tooltip.yanscriptures.classic.aeneid.eff: Non-boss undead will not attack you first; after you are struck by a non-undead, nearby undead strike back for you; an undead you have personally struck regains the right to retaliate.
Poison, wither and instant damage heal you instead; instant health and Regeneration drain your health; hunger restores food and saturation drains food.
tooltip.yanscriptures.classic.aeneid.quo: "I sing of arms and of a man."
tooltip.yanscriptures.classic.analects.e: Each of your pets or minions within 16 blocks grants +5% damage dealt, up to 10 of them.
After dealing damage, heal 1% of your max health per pet or minion.
tooltip.yanscriptures.classic.analects.q: "To learn and in due time practise what one has learned — is that not a joy?"
tooltip.yanscriptures.classic.art_of_war: Hits from behind always crit and deal +30% damage; +15% damage against creatures that have not targeted you yet.
tooltip.yanscriptures.classic.capital.ef: Killing a creature grants capital equal to its max health (at most 100 per kill); trading with a piglin +15, with a villager +50.
Every 500 capital grants +1% attack damage (up to +30%); capital is halved on death and is not cleared when you leave the game.
tooltip.yanscriptures.classic.category.p: Philosophy · How to See the World
tooltip.yanscriptures.classic.category.s: Science · The Rules of the World
tooltip.yanscriptures.classic.crime_and_: Each enemy you personally kill adds one layer of guilt, up to 10. Each layer: +2% damage dealt and +2% damage taken; cleared on death or when unequipped.
At 10 layers the invulnerability window after a hit is 0.2 s shorter, but final damage taken becomes ×1.2.
"I killed myself, not that old woman."
tooltip.yanscriptures.classic.critique_o: Each kind of enchantment in your inventory (counted per slot: no repeat within a slot, repeats across slots allowed, enchanted books excluded) grants +0.5% damage dealt and +1% max health.
When more than 21 slots hold items and all of them carry enchantments you gain creative flight; creatures you have never attacked deal -20% damage to you.
"Two things fill the mind with ever new and increasing admiration: the starry heavens above me and the moral law within me."
tooltip.yanscriptures.classic.dao_de_jin: Your health can drop to 0 without killing you; the bar simply looks empty.

While at empty health, each hit taken raises Regeneration by one level, up to V. Returning from empty to full health kills you. If health is below 5 (or 10% of max, whichever is higher) when the 30 seconds end, you die as well. Permanent Regeneration II.
"Reversion is the movement of the Way; weakness is the function of the Way."
tooltip.yanscriptures.classic.de_revolut: The sun, moon and earth orbit around you (triangular orbit, one circle per 10 seconds, radius 1.5 blocks).

Earth touching an enemy → random beneficial effect for 15 seconds (repeats raise its level); Moon → 20% attack damage plus a random harmful effect, stronger the closer it is to midnight; Sun → 150% attack damage, 250% at noon and 50% at midnight.
"The Sun sits at the centre of all things and governs the stars."
tooltip.yanscriptures.classic.divine_com: Shift + T crosses you into another random dimension; on landing you gain 60 seconds of Resistance II, Regeneration III, Night Vision and Fire Resistance.
"Abandon all hope, ye who enter here."
tooltip.yanscriptures.classic.don_quixot: When an enemy's health is 10× your max health, +20% damage; at 20× or more, +50%.
"Those are giants; if you are afraid, step aside."
tooltip.yanscriptures.classic.euclid.eff: Each of the five axioms blocks one lethal hit for you; the five postulates then grant: -10% damage taken, +10% damage dealt, +20% experience, no single hit above 90% of max health, +1 block reach.
Ten minutes after the first axiom is spent, all axioms are rewritten.
tooltip.yanscriptures.classic.euclid.quo: "What is not proven cannot be counted as knowledge."
tooltip.yanscriptures.classic.faust.effe: Shift + right-click to sign the pact: you permanently lose 20% of your max health (at least 5 points remain).
In exchange, for 60 seconds: +50% damage dealt, -50% damage taken, +50% movement speed. 60 second cooldown; restored on respawn.
tooltip.yanscriptures.classic.faust.quot: "Stay a while — you are so fair!"
Each level of Hero of the Village grants +15% max health and +15% attack damage.
Holding a sword, hold R for 5 seconds to release Enuma Elish, the Star of Creation: 10000% attack damage to enemies along its path. 10 minute cooldown.
tooltip.yanscriptures.classic.hamlet.eff: Each attack rerolls its own damage by chance: 15% deals only 10%, 35% deals 50%, 35% deals 150%, 15% deals 200% and always crits.
The 10% roll banks a guaranteed crit for the next attack that deals damage; it does not stack.
tooltip.yanscriptures.classic.hamlet.quo: "To be, or not to be, that is the question."
tooltip.yanscriptures.classic.hundred_ye: With no other player within 24 blocks: +20% damage dealt and -20% damage taken.
+40% damage while carrying fewer than 5 items; once more than half the inventory is full, item tooltips are hidden.
"The past was a lie, that memory has no return."
tooltip.yanscriptures.classic.i_ching.ef: While worn, a hexagram is cast every 60 seconds, one of six at random: Qian (+10% attack), Kun (damage reduction and reflection), Zhen (movement speed and bonus damage), Kan (water breathing and bonus damage), Li (sets targets alight, fire immunity), Gen (heavy damage reduction while standing still).
When the hexagram changes, the previous one ends at once; only one is ever active.
tooltip.yanscriptures.classic.i_ching.qu: "When things reach their limit they change; change brings passage; passage brings endurance."
tooltip.yanscriptures.classic.iliad.effe: In single combat with exactly one opponent (within 8 blocks): +15% attack damage, -10% damage taken, and neither side can be affected by weakening effects.
When two or more hostile creatures target you: -10% attack damage, but each hit applies a random harmful effect at level II for 8 seconds, and the sweep radius grows to 2.5 blocks.
tooltip.yanscriptures.classic.iliad.quot: "Sing, goddess, the anger of Peleus' son Achilles."
tooltip.yanscriptures.classic.inner_cano: Damage taken is reduced by "current health percentage minus 50%": halved at full health, unreduced at half health or below.

Every 30 seconds it cycles through wood, fire, earth, metal and water: +15% max health → +15% attack → knockback immunity → +15% armor → +15% movement and attack speed. The current phase is shown below.
"The superior physician treats the illness before it arises, not after."
tooltip.yanscriptures.classic.interpreta: Shift + D to dream for 30 seconds: pass through walls, fly, ignore gravity, movement speed back to normal; creatures within 32 blocks dream along with you.
Damage dealt while dreaming does not land; 30% of it is settled when you wake, and you return to where you fell asleep. 10 minute cooldown.
"A dream is the fulfilment of a wish."
tooltip.yanscriptures.classic.materia_me: Beneficial effects from potions and food gain +2 levels (Resistance can only be raised while it is at level I–II).
"Everything can be medicine; it depends on whether it is used in the right place."
tooltip.yanscriptures.classic.nicomachea: While fighting a hostile creature, every 5 consecutive seconds without being hit adds one tier: +15% movement speed → +15% attack → +15% crit rate and +30% crit damage → +50% damage dealt → each attack also deals the same damage in a 1 block radius.
Tiers only increase; being hit or leaving combat for 10 seconds clears them all. Hitting passive creatures does not count as combat.
"Virtue comes from habit — we are what we repeatedly do."
tooltip.yanscriptures.classic.nine_chapt: Attack with hotbar slots 1/1/2/3/5/8 in Fibonacci order: the matching slots give +10%/10%/20%/30%/50%/80% in turn.
One mistake in the order clears every stacked bonus and makes the next hit -10%.
"The equal-transport rule levels distances and balances labour and cost."
tooltip.yanscriptures.classic.odyssey.ef: You drop no items on death; for 30 seconds after respawning you gain Regeneration IV, Absorption IV, Strength III and Swiftness III.
With keepInventory on, Shift + right-click teleports you back to your last death point.
tooltip.yanscriptures.classic.odyssey.qu: "Tell me, O Muse, of that man of many devices."
tooltip.yanscriptures.classic.on_war.eff: 50% of damage taken is converted into "morale", capped at 20% of your max health.
At full morale your next attack is a guaranteed crit and adds true damage equal to the morale; morale then resets and can build again at once. Cleared after 10 seconds out of combat.
tooltip.yanscriptures.classic.one_thousa: Sleep through a whole night: a random attribute (attack, armor, toughness, max health, attack speed, movement speed) +1%, stacking up to 1001 times; the bonus is shown in the book slot panel.
While also wearing the Ring of Seven Curses its seventh curse is cancelled; once per day [Story]: when health drops below 10% you are saved at once.
"As long as the story is not finished, I must not die."
tooltip.yanscriptures.classic.origin.eff: After taking the same kind of damage 10 times in a row, that type is permanently reduced by 25%, with no limit on how many types; environmental damage -50%.
After defeating the same boss a second time, +100% damage against it (permanent).
tooltip.yanscriptures.classic.origin.quo: "It is not the strongest that survives, but the most adaptable."
tooltip.yanscriptures.classic.records_of: Each advancement completed: +0.2% crit rate, +0.5% crit damage, +0.2 luck.
Advancement counts accumulate permanently with no cap.
"To probe the boundary of heaven and man, and to comprehend the changes of past and present."
tooltip.yanscriptures.classic.republic.e: Attacking a creature casts its own shadow beside it; damage dealt to the shadow is transferred to the body in full.
tooltip.yanscriptures.classic.republic.q: "What they see are only shadows on the wall."
tooltip.yanscriptures.classic.summa_theo: Damage taken grants [Son]: a hit above 700% of your max health is voided entirely and costs no health; otherwise it can take at most 49% of your max health and heals you for 10% of that damage. Damage dealt grants [Father]: each second deal 10% of your attack damage to hostile creatures within 1.5 blocks (counted as your attack, no invulnerability used). Experience grants [Spirit]: +50% experience, double mob drops, +10% movement and attack speed, +0.5 block reach.

One layer of each mark, all can be active at once, lasting 10 seconds and refreshing on repeat; while also wearing The Covenant Codex the bracketed values apply (heal 70%, radius 10.5, damage 70%, speed 70%, reach 3.5, duration 70 seconds). Each Ten Commandments blessing you hold adds another +5% to the base values.
tooltip.yanscriptures.classic.the_count_: Creatures that have damaged you are entered on a revenge list: +20% damage dealt to them, plus another 20% if they have ever killed you.
While the list is not empty, +25% attack speed; listed creatures glow red and show "Revenge" when struck.
"All human wisdom is contained in these two words: wait and hope."
tooltip.yanscriptures.classic.the_prince: Above 80% health: +8% attack damage. Below 30% health: -15% damage taken and +10% movement speed.
Within 16 blocks, your pets and minions gain +20% health, armor and attack damage.
"It is much safer to be feared than loved."
tooltip.yanscriptures.classic.thirty_six: Below 30% health, automatically "run away": invisible for 6 seconds, movement speed ×2, 30 second cooldown.
On activation nearby creatures immediately abandon their grudge against you and you cannot be targeted while invisible; while worn, nearby creatures' detection range is -35%.
"Of the thirty-six stratagems, running away is the best."
tooltip.yanscriptures.classic.tiangong_k: Enchanting table base level +20 (applies while worn by a player within 8 blocks of the table).
"Skill surpasses nature; things are opened and completed."
tooltip.yanscriptures.classic.wealth_of_: Every 11 different items across hotbar and inventory grants 1 point of wealth (up to 3).

1 point: +20% experience · 2 points: no single hit above 80% of max health · 3 points: a follow-up of 30% damage in a 1 block radius; higher tiers include lower ones, and the current points are shown below.
"It is not from the benevolence of the butcher that we expect our dinner, but from their regard to their own interest."
tooltip.yanscriptures.classic.zarathustr: While worn, all Ten Commandments stop working: blessings and curses alike.
Each curse suppressed: -3% to attack damage, max health, armor and movement speed. Each blessing suppressed: +4% to the same four.
"He who fights with monsters should be careful lest he thereby become a monster."
tooltip.yanscriptures.classic.zhuangzi.e: Fall damage is fully negated; hold Space in the air to descend slowly, hold Shift to drop faster.
Gliding grants +20% movement speed; while gliding, hold right-click with an empty hand to propel yourself along your line of sight.
tooltip.yanscriptures.classic.zhuangzi.q: "In the Northern Sea there is a fish, and its name is Kun."
tooltip.yanscriptures.covenant.hotkeys: §8K Break Free · Z Sun Stand Still · J Seven Bowls · F Flight
tooltip.yanscriptures.covenant.line1: §7The old covenant is fulfilled; the new is sealed in blood and fire. Ten commandments made one, seven seals all broken.
tooltip.yanscriptures.covenant.line2: §8"I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end."
tooltip.yanscriptures.covenant.title: §6§l✦  THE COVENANT  ✦
tooltip.yanscriptures.covenant_codex.hin: Hold Shift to view the Twelve Authorities
tooltip.yanscriptures.covenant_codex.pow: §7"The wolf also shall dwell with the lamb, and the leopard shall lie down with the kid."
§7No flesh shall lift a blade against you; even he that has the power of death knows your name.
§6[War Ceases Among Nations]
§7"And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the fragments that remained twelve baskets full."
§7What you receive shall exceed what you asked; nothing that falls to the ground shall be lost.
§6[Five Loaves and Two Fishes]
§7"He took not away the pillar of the cloud by day, nor the pillar of fire by night, from before the people."
§7When danger comes you have already been moved away; the enemy reaches out and grasps only wind.
§6[Pillar of Cloud and Fire]
§7"I will dwell among them, and walk among them; and I will be their God."
§7Those beside you are spared the calamity; the wounds you take, you take for them.
§6[Sanctuary]
§7"Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth."
§7You are struck, yet not unto death; you shall lie down, and you shall rise again.
§6[Covenant of Immortality]
§7"And the sun stood still in the midst of heaven, and hasted not to go down about a whole day."
§7You open your mouth and heaven and earth hold their breath; all things halt between one thought and the next.
§6[The Sun Stands Still]
§7"And the seventh angel poured out his vial into the air, and a great voice came out of the temple, saying: It is done."
§7You raise your hand and seven plagues come upon the earth; not one that stands against you is spared.
§6[Seven Bowls Poured]
§7"I will bless them that bless thee, and curse him that curseth thee."
§7Blades break upon you, poison stops before your feet; those who harm you eat their own fruit.
§6[Untouchable]
§7"Behold, I set before you this day a blessing and a curse."
§7You lay on hands and life flows out; you lay on hands and judgement falls.
§6[Gift of Deuteronomy]
§7"The LORD is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer."
§7Standing before the host, your shield cannot be broken nor your authority taken; your wounds, none can spare.
§6[Rock of Hosts]
§7"I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live."
§7The gates of hell shall not prevail against it; your death has been written into resurrection.
§6[The Resurrection and the Life]
§7"Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron; thou shalt dash them in pieces like a potter's vessel."
§7Each battle you win adds another measure of authority, until all hosts bow before you.
§6[Covenant of Hosts]
tooltip.yanscriptures.covenant_codex.scr: §8(Hold Shift + scroll wheel to page through)
tooltip.yanscriptures.covenant_codex.sub: §7The old covenant is fulfilled; the new one is made in blood and fire.
tooltip.yanscriptures.emerald_tablet.bon: Current bonus: +%s attack damage, +%s max health
tooltip.yanscriptures.emerald_tablet.des: [Wisdom of the Alchemist] Every new potion you brew or drink raises your max health, attack damage and magic damage.
tooltip.yanscriptures.epic_calamity.desc: [Seed of Calamity] Right-click: for 15 seconds your attacks apply Calamity marks, each giving the target +8% damage taken, up to 5 stacks.
When a marked target dies, each stack drops extra experience and heals you for 2 points.
Cost: +15% damage taken during this time.
tooltip.yanscriptures.epic_creation.desc: [Ring of Life] Right-click: Regeneration II for 20 seconds.
Food restores twice as much during this time, and overflow healing turns into absorption.
If you take no damage for 20 seconds or drop below 15% health, you also gain Regeneration VIII for 10 seconds.
tooltip.yanscriptures.epic_ego.desc1: [Self Awakening] Right-click: base attributes doubled for 20 seconds, plus creative flight.
tooltip.yanscriptures.epic_ego.desc2: Cost: 1 hunger point per second; the effect ends when it runs out.
tooltip.yanscriptures.epic_ego.desc3: Kills extend the duration by 2 seconds each (up to 40 seconds).
tooltip.yanscriptures.epic_fate.desc: [Door of Forked Paths] Right-click: for 30 seconds you are immune to one death and are teleported to safety when it happens; if you do not die during that time, you gain Luck III for 60 seconds.
tooltip.yanscriptures.epic_pillar.desc: [Ley Line Anchor] Right-click: for 10 seconds you cannot move, take -50% damage, are almost immune to knockback, and reflect 50% of damage taken back at attackers.
tooltip.yanscriptures.grade.head: Materials: paper %1$s · ink %2$s · binding %3$s
tooltip.yanscriptures.grade.none: Paper I · Ink I · Binding I (no bonus)
tooltip.yanscriptures.principia.desc: [Wisdom of Science] The rarer the ores you obtain, the more attack damage and armor you gain.
tooltip.yanscriptures.principia.max: [Final Form] Highest tier unlocked; +1 block of reach as a bonus.
tooltip.yanscriptures.principia.perfect: [Perfect Form] Knowledge and craftsmanship are both complete.
tooltip.yanscriptures.principia.title: Principia Mathematica
tooltip.yanscriptures.principia.ultimate: [Ultimate Form] The dragon egg's power is yours; the progressive bonus reaches its maximum of 25%.
tooltip.yanscriptures.scroll.blood.desc: This scroll answers to the sixth commandment, "Thou shalt not kill". A voice in the ground speaks for the dead.
tooltip.yanscriptures.scroll.blood.verse: "The voice of thy brother's blood crieth unto me from the ground." — Genesis 4:10
tooltip.yanscriptures.scroll.harp.desc: This scroll answers to the seventh commandment, "Faithfulness". The harp hangs by the river; the song is not given to strangers.
tooltip.yanscriptures.scroll.harp.verse: "How shall we sing the LORD's song in a strange land?" — Psalm 137:4
tooltip.yanscriptures.scroll.rebellion.d: This scroll answers to the fifth commandment, "Honour". Those who were raised turn on those who raised them.
tooltip.yanscriptures.scroll.rebellion.v: "I have nourished and brought up children, and they have rebelled against me." — Isaiah 1:2
§f§lYou have passed through that judgement and entered the new heaven and new earth
A fragment outside the Ten Commandments. The last words are written in blood.
When that day comes and a great rite is held, this fragment will reveal the end and the beginning.
"I am he that liveth, and was dead; and, behold, I am alive for evermore, and have the keys of hell and of death." — Revelation 1:18
tooltip.yanscriptures.scroll.sabbath.des: This scroll answers to the fourth commandment, "Sabbath". Even the Creator rested from his work.
tooltip.yanscriptures.scroll.sabbath.ver: "And on the seventh day God ended his work which he had made; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work." — Genesis 2:2
tooltip.yanscriptures.scroll.shema.desc: This scroll answers to the first commandment, "One". Thou shalt have no other gods before me.
tooltip.yanscriptures.scroll.shema.verse: "Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God is one LORD." — Deuteronomy 6:4
tooltip.yanscriptures.scroll.shinar.desc: This scroll answers to the eighth commandment, "Thou shalt not steal". What was taken was burned together with the tent.
tooltip.yanscriptures.scroll.shinar.vers: "I coveted them, and took them." — Joshua 7:21
tooltip.yanscriptures.scroll.silence.des: This scroll answers to the second commandment, "No Images". Those who trust in the voiceless become like it.
tooltip.yanscriptures.scroll.silence.ver: "They have mouths, but they speak not: eyes have they, but they see not... They that make them are like unto them; so is every one that trusteth in them." — Psalm 115:5-8
tooltip.yanscriptures.scroll.thorns.desc: This scroll answers to the third commandment, "The Holy Name". The name appeared in the fire; it shall not be taken in vain.
tooltip.yanscriptures.scroll.thorns.vers: "And God said unto Moses, I AM THAT I AM." — Exodus 3:14
tooltip.yanscriptures.scroll.tongue.desc: This scroll answers to the ninth commandment, "True Word". The smallest fire kindles the greatest forest.
tooltip.yanscriptures.scroll.tongue.vers: "The tongue is a little member, and boasteth great things... and the tongue is a fire." — James 3:5-6
tooltip.yanscriptures.scroll.usage: §5Right-click in hand · completes this commandment (consumes one fragment)
tooltip.yanscriptures.scroll.vanity.desc: This scroll answers to the tenth commandment, "Contentment". What was gained still does not satisfy.
tooltip.yanscriptures.scroll.vanity.vers: "He that loveth silver shall not be satisfied with silver; nor he that loveth abundance with increase: this is also vanity." — Ecclesiastes 5:10
tooltip.yanscriptures.state.flight.off: Flight: %s enchanted slots / needs more than 21
tooltip.yanscriptures.state.flight.off_e: Flight: %s enchanted slots / needs more than 21, plus %s unenchanted
tooltip.yanscriptures.state.nights: Growth: %s / %s (+1 per full night's sleep, applied to a random attribute)
tooltip.yanscriptures.state.wealth: Wealth: %s / %s (%s distinct items in your inventory, +1 per %s)
tooltip.yanscriptures.worn.all: +%s%% to all attributes (sum of the three)
tooltip.yanscriptures.worn.head: Crafting material bonus:
tooltip.yanscriptures.writing_quill: Shift + right-click a lectern to convert it into a Book Writing Table.
